title: Entry Level Lead Generator
description:
About Fin Muse 
 Fin Muse (finnmuse.co.uk) is a UK-based accounting and bookkeeping firm. We use cloud tools such as Xero, QuickBooks, Sage and NetSuite to simplify financial management for small businesses and entrepreneurs. Our services cover bookkeeping, payroll, tax filing, VAT compliance and financial reporting. We are registered in London and work fully remotely to serve clients efficiently. 
 About the role 
 We're looking for a motivated, confident communicator to join us as a Lead Generation Intern focused on the UK market. This is a strong first step into a career in sales and business development. No experience is needed, because we give you full training. You'll research and qualify potential clients, mainly UK small businesses and start-ups, and pass warm leads to our sales team. 
 Key responsibilities Research potential clients using LinkedIn, social media, Google and UK business directories. Make introductory calls and send personalised emails to UK prospects to start conversations and gather key information. Qualify leads against agreed criteria and hand them to the sales team for follow-up. Keep accurate, up-to-date records in the company CRM. Follow up on inbound enquiries generated by marketing campaigns. Meet weekly and monthly targets for lead volume and data accuracy. Handle prospect data in line with GDPR and UK data-protection rules. 
 What counts as a lead Qualified lead (500): A UK business decision-maker who has agreed to a call or meeting with our sales team / matches the agreed criteria and has confirmed interest. Each lead is verified by the sales team before payout. 
 Converted lead (2,500): A qualified lead that signs up as a paying Fin Muse client. 
 Requirements 
 No prior experience required. Full training is provided. Fluent spoken and written English with a confident phone manner. Basic IT skills: Microsoft Office or Google Workspace. A reliable laptop or PC, a stable internet connection and a headset. Available for at least 90 days and able to work during UK business hours. A positive attitude, willingness to learn and a strong work ethic. Able to work independently and as part of a remote team. An understanding of GDPR and UK data-protection rules, or willingness to learn them. 
 What we offer 
 Uncapped performance commission: 500 per qualified lead and 2,500 per converted sale. A structured training programme and ongoing coaching on UK B2B sales. Internship certificate / experience letter on successful completion. Letter of recommendation for outstanding performers, with a chance of a full-time role. Work from home with flexible hours within the UK shift window. 2 days' leave per month plus [UK / Indian] public holidays. Career growth paths in sales, marketing or business development. A friendly, supportive and collaborative remote team. Internship details 
 Duration: minimum 90 days Location: work from home (India) Stipend: commission only, no fixed stipend 
 Hiring process Application and CV screening First interview: a short call to assess communication and phone manner Final interview with senior leadership 
 Fin Muse never asks candidates for any fee or deposit at any stage of hiring or training.

title: Servicenow Developer
description:
Technical Delivery Leadership Own technical delivery of a module or workstream from design through hypercare. Break architecture into buildable stories and distribute work across the development team. Review every piece of code before it leaves the team, and hold the line on standards. Make day-to-day design decisions inside the architecture already set, and escalate the ones that would change it. Hands-On Build Build the difficult components yourself: complex integrations, scoped applications, and performance-sensitive logic. Own update set and application repository hygiene, merge conflict resolution, and deployment packaging. Troubleshoot production issues and drive them to root cause, not just to a workaround. People and Process Mentor developers, run knowledge transfer, and raise the technical standard of the team. Own estimates for your workstream and be able to defend them under challenge. Run technical onboarding for new joiners so they are productive quickly. Client and Stakeholder Demo to clients and explain technical constraints in terms a business stakeholder understands. Work with the Project Manager on risks, dependencies, and release planning. 
 Required Qualifications 8+ years in IT with 6+ years on ServiceNow. At least 3 full lifecycle ServiceNow implementations. Technical depth across at least two modules. Strong integration experience including MID Server, IntegrationHub, and SSO via SAML or OIDC. Demonstrated code review and mentoring track record, with examples you can describe. Experience with ATF, CI/CD, and source control for ServiceNow. Proven ability to lead a team of 4 to 8 developers in a distributed model. 
 Preferred Qualifications HCLS experience. Delivery for payers, providers, PBMs, or life sciences organizations. CMDB and CSDM design and remediation experience. Platform upgrade execution and technical debt remediation. Multi-instance or domain-separated environments. Now Assist and platform AI capabilities. 
 Certifications Required: Certified System Administrator (CSA). Required or within six months of joining: Certified Application Developer (CAD). Preferred: at least one Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) in a relevant module. 
 First 90 Days Full technical ownership of an assigned workstream, including backlog and estimates. Code review process operating with no unreviewed code reaching the client. Development standards documented and followed by the team. At least one junior developer measurably more productive under your mentorship.
